publication_method: Reviewed HKBZ dependency snapshot on origin/main; no unrelated-history merge or force push

clean_worktree_regression.scope: Independent origin-based worktree, without original dataset tree or uncommitted source imports; local IPC permitted
clean_worktree_regression.preliminary_failures: The initial sandbox run found missing historical dataset paths, a canary test fixture missing a constructor default, and blocked local IPC. Minimal checksum-pinned TRAIN fixtures and test-only setup fixed portability; the final full run used permitted local IPC. No algorithm assertions were removed.

final_guard_and_fixture_followup.note: Includes one label-generator freeze guard test added after full discovery. Across the full run and this followup, all 202 current regression tests were exercised successfully.

repository_smoke.invocation: Executed both tests/test_repository.py test functions directly with a temporary directory; pytest is not installed in the validation environment

boundaries: Only a small synthetic TRAIN-case regression fixture is published; complete datasets and teacher trajectories remain external.
The checkpoint is an engineering-verified Stage3 starting point, not a claim of successful Stage3 training or IGA superiority.
Old local master history and unrelated uncommitted Stage1/Stage3 work are preserved, not pushed into this new branch.
Whitespace-only formatting was applied to selected legacy source files in the publication worktree; model and archived source bytes remain unchanged.
